text: 1、市场全天冲高回落，创业板指午后跌超2%。燃气股逆势走强，东方环宇4连板，洪通燃气涨停。消费股表现活跃，好当家、广百股份、惠发食品等涨停。算力芯片股盘中拉升，燧原科技涨超10%，寒武纪、沐曦股份涨超8%。下跌方面，AI漫剧概念下挫，上海电影跌停；机器人、物理AI概念走低，福莱新材等跌停。个股呈现普跌态势，沪深京三市超4600股飘绿，今日成交1.95万亿。截止收盘沪指跌0.67%，深成指跌1.68%，创业板指跌2.44%。 2、板块概念方面，军工、燃气、白酒、养殖等板块逆势走强，贵金属、游戏、AI漫剧、机器人等板块跌幅居前。 3、两市共838只个股上涨，
text_en: 1. The market rose then fell throughout the day, with the ChiNext Index down more than 2% in the afternoon. Gas stocks strengthened against the trend, with Dongfang Huanyu up for a fourth consecutive session and Hongtong Gas hitting the daily limit. Consumer stocks were active, with Haodangjia, Guangbai Co., and Huifa Food hitting the daily limit. Computing power chip stocks rallied intraday, with Enflame up more than 10%, and Cambricon and MetaX up more than 8%. On the downside, AI comic-drama concept stocks fell, with Shanghai Film hitting the daily limit; robotics and physical AI concept stocks declined, with Fulai New Materials hitting the daily limit. Stocks fell broadly, with more than 4,600 decliners across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets, and turnover today at 1.95 trillion yuan. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.67%, the Shenzhen Component fell 1.68%, and the ChiNext Index fell 2.44%. 2. By sector and concept, defense, gas, baijiu and breeding sectors strengthened against the trend, while precious metals, gaming, AI comic-drama and robotics sectors led the declines. 3.
